name: Great Texas Birding Classic Conservation Grants

funder.name: Texas Parks and Wildlife Department (Great Texas Birding Classic)

summary: Conservation grants funded by Birding Classic proceeds for avian habitat restoration, enhancement and acquisition projects anywhere in Texas; organisations propose projects and winning birding teams choose which approved projects get funded.

steps: Review for the pre-approved project list
Selection by winning Birding Classic teams

status.quote: Does your organization want to propose a project for funding consideration? Conservation Grant Criteria Conservation Grant Proposal Form Conservation Grant Proposal Due Date: May 1, 2027

deadline.quote: Does your organization want to propose a project for funding consideration? Conservation Grant Criteria Conservation Grant Proposal Form Conservation Grant Proposal Due Date: May 1, 2027

geography.quote: Conservation Grants can be awarded to projects anywhere in Texas.

access.quote: Organizations are not required to register a team in the Birding Classic to be eligible to submit a project proposal.

window.quote: Does your organization want to propose a project for funding consideration? Conservation Grant Criteria Conservation Grant Proposal Form Conservation Grant Proposal Due Date: May 1, 2027

effort.quote: Conservation Grant Proposal Due Date: May 1, 2027
These proposals will be reviewed and, if approved, will become part of a pre-approved list of projects eligible to receive Conservation Grants.
All approved projects submitted by the May 1st deadline will be provided to winning Birding Classic teams to select which projects are funded by Conservation Grants.

eligibility.quote: All projects must provide some level of public access.

private land can only be included if the property is under a conservation easement or the owner agrees to a habitat management plan (such as a TPWD wildlife management plan) that provides for public access.
Have a long term or permanent conservation status
Include an avian monitoring component or other related measurement to show conservation success.
Organizations MAY NOT apply for future grant funding through the Birding Classic until all required post-project documentation is submitted to the Birding Classic staff.
The following expenses may not be included as part of the project budget funded by this grant: general overhead costs, salary funding, or purchase of capital equipment

after_award.quote: provide a short written report with digital photos showing project fulfillment at project completion to the Birding Classic staff.

eligibility.rule: Project provides some level of public access
Private land only under a conservation easement or a management plan that provides public access
Project has long-term or permanent conservation status
Project includes avian monitoring or another measure of conservation success
Has submitted all post-project reports for any earlier Birding Classic grant
Budget excludes general overhead, salaries and capital equipment purchases
